author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Oil-led and China-led disinflation is doing the Fed's work, but Powell's hawkish IMF remarks and a weak 30-year auction show the Fed and Treasury supply will not let the long end rally freely, so the edition favours quality cash flow, belly duration and self-help stories over small caps, energy and China-linked materials. The high-beta beneficiaries of a softer dollar, crypto on ETF optionality and Polish banks after the RPP pause, stay long but with explicit political and regulatory triggers.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-10 frozen own-date feed headlines (cited inline as [[nNNNN]] in the same part) and the 2023-11-10 market card; no other date's feeds, cards or drafts, no web, no later knowledge. Spot-FX levels/returns are not quoted; currency direction is taken only from cited headlines. Company news is within seven days, results within fourteen, macro within thirty-five.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0072 (ABC, 'RBA predicts household consumption figures to rise'): likely reflects the RBA Statement on Monetary Policy released on the report date; treated as possibly post-cutoff and not cited.
n0301 (MarketWatch, 'Taylor Swift is Time's person of the year', stamped 2023-11-04): the announcement it describes appears to postdate the cutoff; misdated, not cited.
n1861 (Fortune Business Insights, title referencing 2034): vintage inconsistent with the stamp; not cited.
n1813 (blog, 'Core PCE inflation spiked to 3.6% in September'): figure and definition ambiguous; not cited.
n0924 (CoinDCX, '$4.16 Billion' in spot bitcoin ETFs): low-quality and ambiguous; not cited.
BOJ October 31 policy outcome: only a preview (n1352) exists, so no decision result is claimed.
Polish policy-rate level and NBP fixing quotes (n1591, n1500) and the euro move in n1889: numeric rate/FX values not quoted; only direction and decision status used.
n0598 (Bloom Energy record revenue): the 2023-11-09 gain is not attributed to the print because the post-release session direction is unclear; excluded from the rewarded list.
Price reactions to SoftBank, Sony and PKO BP results are not attributed to the prints because release timing versus the 2023-11-09 sessions is uncertain.
Siemens' results are not claimed; only its 2023-11-09 share move is used.
